subject: Request: Senior exec consideration for hosted API rate variance (30% for 12mo)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@datavista.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask for pilot -> enterprise ramp

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move from a 6-week pilot to an initial production rollout across two product lines. The engineering team estimates ~1.2B tokens / month for Q4 once both lines are live.

Given the volume and the strategic integration (we've committed to bundling Redwood features into our premium offering), can Redwood provide a 30% discount on Hosted API usage for the first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month minimum commitment? We also need a short SOW to include uptime and support response targets.

I've attached a high-level forecast and a draft SOW. Legal will want standard terms but they're open to a short-term concession if we have exec signoff.

Looking forward — can you confirm next steps and timeline?

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
DataVista

Attachments: DataVista_Monthly_Forecast_Q3-4.xlsx, Draft_SOW_DataVista_v3.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing ask for pilot -> enterprise ramp

Ben/Marcus — forwarding DataVista's ask. Quick summary:
- Request: 30% off Hosted API usage for 12 months
- Volume: ~1.2B tokens / month (Q4), potential double in first year if adoption meets targets
- They will commit to a 12-month billing minimum and mention product bundling which could drive wider adoption
- Attachments: forecast + draft SOW

Why I'm escalating: 30% is outside our standard pricing playbook for Hosted API and would normally require senior sign-off. DataVista is strategic (channel potential) but the unit economics are material — need tradeoffs on credits, SLOs, and a clearly scoped ramp.

Ask: Can we get senior exec consideration for a one-time 30% concession locked to a 12-month commitment? If approved, we should present an exact rollback at month 13 (to list or a stepped rate), and require legal to include a performance clause.

Please reply with decision or what additional data you need.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask for pilot -> enterprise ramp

Evelyn — thanks for the clean summary. A few quick thoughts:

1) 30% off is above my operational threshold without CFO sightline; Mina should weigh in on long-run impact and whether we can structure as a usage credit vs. permanent tier cut.
2) If DataVista will publicize integration or provide a case study, we can justify a deeper short-term concession. Need marketing commitment in writing.
3) Request we hold to: 12-month minimum ARR commitment (documented in SOW), quarterly usage gates, and a sunset clause to return to standard pricing (or a pre-agreed stepped rate).

Can we get the forecast ribboned by product line (tokens by route/model) and an estimated monthly spend at current list rates? Mina — can you model a conservative, base, upside revenue case with the concession baked in?

If finance is comfortable, I'm okay taking this to Senior Exec with recommendation to approve conditioned on marketing/case study and legal performance gates.

-Ben
SVP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 17:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask for pilot -> enterprise ramp

Thanks — I ran a quick model. Assumptions in the linked HubSpot deal: baseline churn and conservative adoption. Key outputs:
- At list rates, projected first-year revenue (monthly ramp to steady state) ~ $2.6M ARR.
- With a 30% usage concession for 12 months, net present revenue impact over 12 months is ~ -$520k (off contract NRR headwind).
- If we structure the concession as a usage credit tied to performance gates and require a case study + marketing announcement, the long-term customer LTV increases materially; break-even on LTV uplift assumed in 18-24 months in the conservative case.

Recommendation: Bring to CRO/CEO for approval conditioned on the following terms: 1) 12-month committed minimum (documented in SOW + invoicing cadence), 2) performance gates at Q1 and Q2 with partial clawback if onboarding milestones aren't hit, 3) marketing/case study commitment, 4) legal to include an auto-sunset stepped rate to avoid permanent precedent.

I'll attach the model (summary pasted below) and can present to leadership if you want.

-Mina
VP, Finance — Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Finance_Model_Summary (see related HubSpot link)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec decision: escalate to CRO/CEO for final signoff

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Given the size and channel potential, I agree we should escalate this to CRO and CEO with a recommended approval if finance signs off on the model and legal drafts the SOW with the gated concession.

I'll prepare a one-page exec memo summarizing: ask, forecast impact, required legal clauses, marketing commitment, and rollout milestones. Evelyn — please coordinate with DataVista to confirm the marketing/case study timing and get the signature authority contact at their legal team.

Ben/Mina — please attach your models and the proposed stepped/sunset language you'd like to see in the SOW. Once I have those pieces I'll take to CRO for a decision today.

Marcus
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
